PrototypeHow it's built

Code does the maths. AI judges and explains.

Tech stack

  • Python · pandas · shapely · pyproj
  • OS Features API · Overpass · EPC bulk data
  • Claude Sonnet 5.5 · tool use · cached JSON
  • deck.gl · MapLibre · one HTML file
  • 12 scripts on GitHub

AI vs code

  • Code: geometry, heat loss, costs, checks, every total
  • AI: trust the data? which fixes? what could go wrong?
  • Built with AI-assisted coding (Claude)

Honest limits

  • Not validated against surveyed homes
  • Not a SAP assessment; costs are typical rates
  • Storeys assumed for 44 of 77 buildings
  • Listed status not checked

Next, with Greenflip's data
